Our Mission

So that every traveller who comes to Mongolia will not miss this stainless giant above the steppe, we gathered scattered official information into this guide — for the purest “look up, climb up, read the steppe empire” experience.

Chinggis Khaan Statue Complex (Цонжин Болдог)

Official & Reference Resources

  • Mongolia Travel (Official National Tourism) ↗

    Ministry of Environment and Tourism of Mongolia

    The official national tourism portal of Mongolia, with the official scenic introduction, historical background and HD visual guide to the Chinggis Khaan Statue Complex (Tsonjin Boldog).

  • Ministry of Environment and Tourism of Mongolia ↗

    Government of Mongolia

    The top national government department overseeing tourism development, site planning and environmental policy — extremely high government-domain authority.

  • Ulaanbaatar Tourism Department ↗

    Ulaanbaatar City Government

    Official service platform of the Ulaanbaatar tourism department. Nalaikh District administratively belongs to the capital Ulaanbaatar; the site gives authoritative routes, day-tour planning and official travel advice.

  • Ulaanbaatar City Government ↗

    Ulaanbaatar City Government

    The higher-level local government portal for the statue’s administrative area, used to build localised geo association and administrative authority.

  • Official Portal of the Government of Mongolia ↗

    Government of Mongolia

    The central government’s official unified public-service portal — a national top-level domain link, ideal as a baseline authority boost for the site’s trust score.
